Theorem
[Two-positive curvature operator (Theorem 35.40)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0326 1. ch35:35.40\group Alternative Stability Methods

If a closed simply-connected $n$-manifold, $n\ge 5$, has $2$-positive curvature operator, then volume-normalized Ricci flow converges to a unique constant-positive-curvature metric.
